own_solution.law: Kirchhoff's current law gives C dV/dt=(E-V)/R1-V/R2. With V(0)=0, V(t)=V_final[1-exp(-t/tau)], where V_final=E R2/(R1+R2) and tau=(R1 R2/(R1+R2))C. Consequently t_90=ln(10)(4700*6800/11500)(22e-6)=0.140782 s=140.782 ms.

An added capacitor wired across the main capacitor remains connected during charging and shares its zero initial voltage.
